query: SELECT cas_number, COUNT(*) as cnt, GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY id) as ids, GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY id SEPARATOR ' | ') as names FROM molecules WHERE cas_number IS NOT NULL AND cas_number != '' GROUP BY cas_number HAVING cnt > 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 20;
